scope: Day 1-18 student learning flow with focus on Day 7-18 question-quality layer
checks: normal fast-flow content loads after accuracy and question-quality patches
deterministic answer reordering moves correct option and answer index together
normal fast flow and adaptive fast review consume the same patched content
per-question qualityDiagnosis overrides generic D2/D3/D4 heuristic
wrong answer -> diagnosis -> repair O/X -> same original question retry remains intact
O/X miss keeps learner in repair and shows correction before rejudging
resolved adaptive-review items are excluded from actionable review queue
next-action recommendation never points to an empty resolved fast-review queue
legacy transient selected-option state is cleared once after answer-position migration while progress/history remain preserved

defects_found_and_fixed.problem: A learner who had an option selected in an old Day 7-18 session could reopen after deterministic option reordering and see the old numeric selected index applied to the new option order.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: fast_boost_hook.js now performs a one-time QA-version migration that clears only transient answered/repair state while preserving index, accumulated history, wrong counts, finished state, and synced progress.

defects_found_and_fixed.problem: A question already solved in adaptive review could remain actionable because historical wrong-count weight stayed above threshold; recommendation could then open a review page with no unresolved item.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: weakness_profile_engine.js keeps resolved mistakes in weakness statistics at reduced weight but filters them out of weakFastDetail actionable queues and skips fast-day review recommendations that have no unresolved question.

day1_to_day6.regression_result: no new code-path modification in this QA; existing adaptive depth -> original question retry architecture retained

day7_to_day18.regression_result: pass after the two concrete fixes above

storage_policy: Historical learning events are never rewritten. Only obsolete transient current-option state is reset once for compatibility with reordered choices.
next_policy: Do not start another broad redesign. From this point, fix only defects observed in actual learner use or explicitly requested UX/content changes.
